summary: Warren recognizes AI’s promise while calling for an advanced-development pause, public safeguards and a fair distribution of benefits and costs.

statements.quote: We should immediately press pause on the development of advanced AI while lawmakers and regulators put systems in place to keep people safe.
The American people deserve to share in the success of this technology.
statements.venue: TIME op-ed, reproduced by Senate office

statements.quote: I cannot say what the future of this technology will hold—what new inventions or expanded capacities will bring.
Meaningful constraints to prevent civilian harm in warfare are a moral, legal, and strategic necessity
statements.venue: Letter to OpenAI, Senate office publication

statements.quote: But these tools should not be deployed in a way that asks taxpayers to shoulder the risks while enriching company executives and investors.
statements.venue: Letter to OpenAI, Senate office publication
